verdict.rationale: Logseq's official Export docs say it exports the entire graph in several open formats: EDN, JSON, standard Markdown, OPML, Roam JSON and HTML. That directly supports leaving with your whole knowledge base at any time, and a user values its local data. One community report says Logseq's Markdown files carry indentation quirks that clash with tools like Obsidian. That is a compatibility caveat, not a contradiction of the export capability. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that full-graph exports round-trip cleanly into other tools, clarity on export fidelity in the new database version.
